papers.title: SiC Detectors for Sub-GeV Dark Matter
papers.summary: We propose the use of silicon carbide (SiC) for direct detection of sub-GeV dark matter. SiC has properties similar to both silicon and diamond, but has two key advantages: (i) it is a polar semiconductor which allows sensitivity to a broader range of dark matter candidates; and (ii) it exists in many stable polymorphs with varying physical properties, and hence has tunable sensitivity to various dark matter models.
